item.title: Russian GRU General Vladimir Alexeyev Shot in Moscow, Hospitalized in Critical Condition
item.description: Russian GRU Lieutenant General Vladimir Alexeyev was shot three times in Moscow in an apparent assassination attempt. He was shot in the stairwell of his apartment building while leaving his residence. Bisrati is currently hospitalized and remains in critical condition.
